dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures display high-contrast, dark perimeters with sharp gradient transitions to lighter internal regions, particularly prominent on the dorsal-lateral flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low to moderate density of small, asymmetrical dark pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, distributed across the lower lateral edge and near the tail base.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent macro-annuli on the upper mid-section form a scalene triangle with the longest side oriented parallel to the longitudinal axis.
